visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 2D animation of a male character with short dark hair sitting in front of a laptop. The background is a cyan polka-dot pattern within a television-like frame. Yellow speech bubbles with Chinese text appear next to him. (2) The scene transitions to a series of book covers and promotional posters featuring a man in glasses, identified as Kenji Shimizu. The man is seen in various poses, some pointing to his eyes or face. (3) A live-action shot of Kenji Shimizu appears; he is sitting in a brightly lit indoor living room with a bookshelf behind him. He wears glasses and a dark blazer, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. Subtitles and graphic overlays with facial expression examples appear intermittently. (4) The screen shifts to a digital interface view, showing a web browser with a course syllabus. A digital hand cursor scrolls through the list of chapters and lessons. (5) Motion graphics illustrate human communication concepts using icons like eyes, speech bubbles, and colored circles labeled 'Love', 'Family', and 'Workplace'. (6) The animated character returns, now accompanied by a round white robotic mascot. A large orange box with a coupon code 'WEIS250' slides in from the left. (7) The final phase shows a fast montage of course slides and a final promotional graphic for the 'Micro-expression' course on the PressPlay platform.

(4) The narrator's speech remains constant in volume and clarity, with no background environmental noise. (5) A 'Whoosh' SFX triggers as the screen transitions from the live-action instructor to the digital syllabus. (6) A series of 'Pop' and 'UI Click' sounds are heard as the cursor scrolls through the list of course contents. (7) When describing communication graphics, 'Whoosh' sounds emphasize each transition between 'Love', 'Family', and 'Workplace'.
